interpretation: LCP is text on home/contact/quality. It is not a delayed hero-image request.
The font-display insight has no estimated savings.
Reported scoring metrics use simulated throttling. Insight subpart durations are trace-derived and must not be added directly to simulated LCP or treated as a physical-device latency measurement.
The remaining blocking assistant stylesheet has100–150ms estimated LCP saving in these pages. This opportunity does not explain private-page startup.

Shared client runtime, hydration, localization/publication parsing and page content remain measurable costs. Coverage-reported unused bytes include legitimate later interactions; deleting them would be incorrect.
No score above the actual measured result is predicted. No further app-source change was made after the accepted build.
